rulesTestNames: lets managers read live guest and settings views and nothing else
owner: Live guest and settings view evaluator: hostReadModels guest view triggers
read: current organizer managers get their own organizer's views by id; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; one per event with an eventFormat and an endTime, deleted with the event
migrationNotes: status and canConfigure are evaluated one millisecond before eventEndAtMillis and closed is the event's own closure; the phone closes the automation at the end and expires a configured window by the app clock.
The sender picker stays on getEventAssistanceRuntimeConfig with senderCursors; the view carries no senderSetup.
